kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

lines.say: Lying awake tonight with a lot on your mind? Hear this.
lines.big: Lying awake tonight with a lot on your mind

lines.say: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah. Psalm four, verse four.
lines.big: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

lines.say: Talk to him about it on your bed, then let it be still.
lines.big: Talk to him about it on your bed, then let it be still.

lines.say: Lord, I'm handing you what's on my heart tonight. Make me still. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 1 through 31, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
